mapper.select: SELECT id, dm_id as dmId, resource_name as resourceName, file_name as fileName, file_path as filePath, file_size as fileSize, file_type as fileType, remark, operator, TO_CHAR(operate_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as operateTime, create_by as createBy, TO_CHAR(create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as createTime FROM ietm_dm_resource WHERE dm_id = #{dmId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
